tools.name: search_marketplace
tools.description: Search 39,762 items (24,385 marketplace listings + 14,718 local shop items) in NYC & Northern NJ by keyword, category, or borough.

query.description: Search term or item name (e.g. 'dining table', 'tiffany bracelet', 'sofa', 'airpods', 'puffer jacket')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 15, max 50)

tools.name: get_item_details
tools.description: Get complete structured item details (photos, verified price, condition, seller, neighborhood, and similar available items) by Moonoh item ID or URL.

id.description: Moonoh item ID (e.g. 'karrot-uh7b3dkne8ex', 'heykorean-674246') or Moonoh item URL

tools.name: get_price_report
tools.description: Get real-time pricing statistics, median prices, and category breakdowns across 39,762 items (24,385 marketplace listings + 14,718 local shop items) in NYC boroughs and Northern NJ.

tools.name: search_churches
tools.description: Search verified Manhattan Protestant churches and worship services by keyword, neighborhood, or worship language (America/New_York).

query.description: Church name, neighborhood, or community keyword

neighborhood.description: Manhattan neighborhood (e.g. 'Chelsea', 'Upper West Side', 'Chinatown / Lower East Side')

includePending.description: Include 'Details being verified' candidates without pins (default false)

tools.name: get_church_details
tools.description: Get full church identity, separate service-level times/venues/languages, verification status, source URLs, and canonical Moonoh detail URL by church slug.
